declared difference (truth fix T3, queue field names): the awk named a Deque/Queue line after its first `<name> =`
and skipped a name that was a substring of the names so far, so `Queue<B> pending;` printed "(Deque/Queue field)",
`waiting` was hidden by `waitingQueue`, `busy = a == b; Queue<B> spare` printed busy, and `head = null, tail`
lost tail. Every declarator of a Deque<…>/Queue<…> type is named now (not the `new ArrayDeque<>()` it is
assigned), each once by exact name.
